headline: KEC International Stock Falls After Weak Q2 2027 Profit Report
summary: KEC International reported weak Q2 2027 profit, causing its stock price to decline by 9.8%.
why: Quarterly earnings shortfalls directly impact equity valuations and investor sentiment toward engineering and infrastructure contractors.

impacts.name: KEC International
impacts.why: Weak quarterly profits directly drove a sharp decline in the company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing quarterly financial results led to an immediate sell-off in the company's shares.
